Share count 142,486,558 printed in full, converted to thousands (142,486.558); FFO 396,755/142,486.558 = 2.78 and Core 403,326/142,486.558 = 2.83, matching reported per-share figures. Same reconciliation also appears on seq 32 (printed page 19); values identical. Recurring capex: no AFFO and no capex table on the supplied pages, so null. Category judgments: 'Other real estate activity' (gains on non-operating real estate plus imputed carry cost) and 'Income tax benefit' recorded as 'other'; SIP loan reserve recorded as 'other'.
